description:
Export a complete copy of your account's data (GDPR Articles 15 and 20), or check on one. Owner only: sign in with start_login first (a connection with only an API key is refused user_session_required). The first call starts the export; it is prepared in the background, and the account owner is told by email (or on their login channel) with a link that downloads it only while they are signed in — this tool never returns the data itself. Call again to see whether it is ready: an export already preparing or ready is reported instead of starting another. One new export per 24 hours (no limit while the account is scheduled for deletion); the file is kept for 7 days. Pass export_id to read one export's status.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.

export_id.description: Read this export's status instead of the latest one

name: export_data

counts.description: Rows per section of the file

download_path.description: Path of the download route while `ready`, else null

error.description: `too_large` — more than one download can carry (no partial file is ever produced; contact support); `internal` — a failure on our side (start a new export at once, the daily limit was given back)

expires_at.description: The export and its file are deleted at this time — 7 days after the request

receipts.description: Receipts of the account's downloads, newest first (the latest 20)

size_bytes.description: Size of the compressed file as stored

status.description: `preparing` while the job runs; `ready` once the file can be downloaded; `failed` with `error`
